verdict.detail: The same year as the first issue (UK, TPSA 7515, 1975).

notes.text:
All the music contained on this album was conceived, written and recorded in 'Musicland' Studios, Munich, West Germany, during 3rd August 1975 to 1st September 1975.

Release includes lyrics sheet.

All titles published by Deep Purple Music (Overseas) Limited except 'Lady Luck' which is published by Intersong Music Limited.
Group photography and inside spread photography by courtesy of Bravo magazine
